title: Design Technologist, eShop
description:
**Description**
 Help shape the future of AI\-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production \- shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.
   

  

 We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world\-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production\-grade visual content
* Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
* Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
* Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production\-ready capabilities
* Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling


 This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver \- someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
* Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
* Evaluate AI\-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness \- applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
* Support the fine\-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
* Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high\-quality results at scale across content types
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
* Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities \- assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
* Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI\-created assets efficiently
* Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
* Participate in cross\-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI\-generated image outputs \-tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers \- solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products \- through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
* 3\+ years of experience in front\-end technology, engineering, or UX prototyping
* Coding samples in front\-end programming languages
* Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work
* Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front\-end development
* Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
* Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large\-scale computing environments
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design
* Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and source control (Git)
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team
* Knowledge of video production, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post\-production techniques, production calendars and staffing

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

title: Supply Chain Digital Transformation Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 The Supply Chain Digital Transformation Lead is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end digital transformation of the supply chain function through the application of technology, data and artificial intelligence, spanning demand planning, supply planning, procurement, distribution and cost. It is accountable for identifying, evaluating and implementing the digital tools and applications that transform each process, and for leading the associated change through to adoption.
 



 Working across the planning, procurement, distribution, finance and technology teams, the role sets the digital transformation agenda, develops the business case for technology and artificial intelligence investment, and leads the selection, implementation and adoption of supply chain applications. The function leaders retain ownership of their processes and outcomes; the role partners with them to ideate, evaluate and deploy the right solutions and to strengthen the overall capability, efficiency and effectiveness of the supply chain.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Digital Strategy \& Technology Roadmap
 


* Define the multi\-year technology and AI roadmap for the supply chain, prioritizing the tools and applications to be introduced across planning, sourcing, distribution and cost.
* Evaluate and select supply chain solutions through build\-versus\-buy assessment, vendor and platform evaluation, and proof\-of\-concept against clearly defined use cases.
* Build the business case for each technology investment, covering value at stake, cost and sequencing, and secure leadership alignment behind it.



 B. Planning Systems — Demand \& Supply
 


* Identify, evaluate and implement Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and AI\-based demand forecasting to replace spreadsheet\-based, brand\-wise planning, with the S\&OP leader owning the planning process.
* Deploy the Auto\-Replenishment System (ARS) and inventory\-optimization tools for supply planning, working with the supply planning leader who owns norms and service levels.
* Configure the planning applications, integrations and data flows, and transition operational ownership to the planning leaders.



 C. Sourcing \& Procurement Systems
 


* Evaluate and implement e\-sourcing and e\-auction platforms, contract lifecycle management (CLM) and supplier relationship management (SRM), with the category leaders owning sourcing strategy and negotiations.
* Introduce spend analytics, should\-cost and commodity\-index tools to support category and cost decisions.
* Digitize supplier onboarding, performance scorecards and share\-of\-business tracking on a common platform.



 D. Warehouse, Logistics \& Network Systems
 


* Warehouse Management (WMS) and Transport Management (TMS) systems
* Deploy network\-optimization and route\-optimisation tools to inform network design and secondary distribution.
* Implement a supply chain control tower for network\-wide visibility, exception management and early\-warning alerts.



 E. Cost, Analytics \& Decision Systems
 


* Implement cost\-to\-serve and costing\-and\-allocation tools that provide a clear, system\-based view of where cost sits across the value chain, with SC Finance owning the numbers.



 F. Data, AI \& Automation Platforms
 


* Identify and implement workflow automation and process automation to remove manual, repetitive tasks across supply chain processes.
* Establish the data foundation, master data and integration layer required for reliable analytics and AI across the applications landscape.
* Ideate, pilot and scale artificial intelligence and machine\-learning use cases — such as forecasting, anomaly detection and prescriptive recommendations — in partnership with IT and solution providers.



 Key Projects \& Initiatives
 


* The role will lead a portfolio of digital initiatives that convert core supply chain processes from manual to system\-run. Indicative programmers include:
* Advanced demand planning and AI\-based forecasting — a statistical and machine\-learning forecasting engine integrated with auto\-replenishment.
* MRP automation in SAP (SAP\-VC) — automated material requirement planning, purchase scheduling and vendor call\-off.
* Auto\-replenishment and auto\-indent (ARS) — system\-driven store and distribution\-Centre replenishment based on demand signals.
* Supply chain control tower — a single, real\-time view for exception management and early\-warning alerts.
* Analytics and management dashboards (e.g., Tableau) — automated MIS, self\-service reporting and Capex and new\-store (NSO) pipeline tracking.



 Key Relationships
 



 Internal
 


* Head of Supply Chain Management \& Logistics — reporting line and transformation sponsor.
* Demand Planning \& S\&OP, Supply Planning, Category Management \& Procurement, Capex \& NSO, and Warehouse, Logistics \& Distribution, SC Finance — cost, costing analysis and value realization.
* IT, Digital and Business teams — joint partners in delivering supply chain technology and AI solutions and adopting the new ways of working.



 External
 


* Management consultants and transformation advisors.
* Supply chain benchmarking and best\-practice networks.
* Key suppliers, 3PL and logistics partners.
* Technology, AI and solution providers.



 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* 7–12 years in supply chain, with a strong track record of leading technology\- and AI\-enabled transformation across planning, procurement and distribution.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Technology, Supply Chain or Operations; a postgraduate qualification (MBA / SCM) is preferred.
* Deep expertise in supply chain technology \& tools including advanced planning, automation, analytics and AI/ML applications.
* Demonstrated success leading digital transformation programmers end to end, from strategy and business case through to implementation and adoption.
* Strong grounding in cost and costing analysis, value realization and business\-case development.
* Exposure to QSR, food, FMCG or multi\-site retail distribution, or a management\-consulting background, is an advantage.



 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end supply chain and its digital and AI enablement — demand and supply planning, procurement, distribution and cost.
* Strong command of supply chain technology and artificial intelligence, including advanced planning, automation, data and analytics.
* Strategic, structured problem\-solving; able to design a target operating model and a roadmap to reach it.
* Programmer leadership across multiple concurrent workstreams and senior stakeholders.
* Change leadership — able to influence, challenge and land new ways of working without direct authority.
* Strong commercial and cost acumen; comfortable with costing analysis and value cases.
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management.



 A structured, outside\-in mindset focused on continuous improvement and best practice

title: Assistant Project Coordinator- (Research)/Senior Researcher - Delhi
description:
Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research) / Senior Researcher
 



 Indian Police Foundation \| Internal Police Reforms Project
 



  





 Organisation: Indian Police Foundation
 



 Project: Internal Police Reforms Project
 



 Location: Indian Police Foundation HQ, New Delhi (C\-8, 8758, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi \- 110070\)
 



 Number of Positions: 1
 



 Tenure: Contractual. Offered initially for 1 year but extendable till the completion of the project (2027\-2028\).
 



 Remuneration: Rs. 75,000 per month (Assistant Project Coordinator \- Research) / Rs. 60,000 per month (Senior Researcher), including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance.
 



 Last date to apply: 5 October 2026, till 4:00 PM only.
 



  





 OVERVIEW
 



  





 Applications are invited for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher on a contractual basis.
 



  





 Candidates possessing a minimum of 3 years or more of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator (Research). However, candidates shortlisted with less than 3 years of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Senior Researcher.
 



  





 Although the position is in Delhi, the APC\- Research/Senior Researcher is expected to travel to various (3 states) both for research as well as project implementation and monitoring.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 The role of the Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher involves coordinating both the research and operational components of the Internal Police Reforms Project. Working closely with the Project Director (PD), Project Coordinator (PC), and State Supervisors, the he/she will play a key role in project planning, research, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and documentation across three states (Punjab, Telangana \& Tamil Nadu).
 



  





 ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 \- Educational Qualification: M.A in Social Sciences/Police Sciences/Criminology/Public Safety or any other related field. However, candidates with Ph.D. in relevant domains will be preferred.
 



 \- Researcher/Consultant with experience of 3 years or more in social research in universities, other research institutes, NGOs, think tanks, or consulting firms. (Minimum experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Project Director).
 



 \- Experience in Independent Research Study Design and leading/mentoring research team.
 



 \- Proficiency \& experience in developing and conducting Baseline, Midline and Endline evaluation study.
 



 \- Proficiency in Research Tool Development for empirical data collection.
 



 \- Proficiency in mixed\-data \- quantitative and qualitative \- analysis \& and knowledge of quantitative data analysis software (advance excel, SPSS/STATA).
 



 \- Ability to understand and communicate the meaning of field\-based data and writing research report.
 



 \- Strong management, coordination and leadership skills for engagement with senior police officers, trainers, research staff and other research institutions.
 



 \- High level of proficiency in computer skills.
 



 \- Willingness and good health to undertake field visits (as and when required).
 



 \- Good command over English and Hindi.
 



 \- Attend the IPF office at Vasant Kunj, Delhi, on a regular basis.
 



  





 DESIRABLE
 



  





 \- Previous experience of working with Police organisations.
 



 \- Familiarity with criminal laws (major \& minor).
 



 \- Familiarity with relevant Supreme Court judgments \& NHRC directives.
 



 \- Familiarity with MHA and State Government circulars related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Familiarity with recommendations of various police commissions, including the National Police Commission (1979\-81\), related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Publications of Research papers/articles in various journals/magazines/Newspapers.
 



  





 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Research and Data Analysis
 



  





 \- Head the research team, provide guidance to Research Associates both in Headquarters \& States, and monitor their work.
 



 \- Guide Research Associates in data analysis for various stakeholders for both quantitative and qualitative data collected through three tools (structured questionnaires, FGDs, and in\-depth interviews).
 



 \- Coordinate with and visit the external agencies engaged for data analysis \& report writing (Centre for Economic \& Social Studies, Hyderabad \& Centre for Good Governance, Hyderabad).
 



 \- Guide and Supervise Research Associates in desk research, including analysis of reports of the National Police Commission and other committees on police reforms.
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to State DGP on Public Grievances in 3 states based on data analysis.
 



  





 2\. Formulation of Change Manual
 



  





 \- Assist in the Formulation of Change Manual \& its action plan for all the 3 states based on the Project Focus areas, namely improving Compliant / FIR Registration and Police Response, improving Citizen Services and Community Engagement, prevention of Harassment by Police, and improving Police Conduct and Behaviour.
 



 \- Presentation of Change Manual to the respective state DGPs in 3 States.
 



  





 3\. Baseline and Endline Evaluation
 



  





 \- Work on evaluation parameters, selection of police stations for evaluation, training of field enumerators, and ensure that the data required by the agency for conducting baseline and endline evaluations is provided in a timely manner.
 



 \- Guide in the formulation of Data Collection Tools by evaluation agencies.
 



 \- Support and monitor the execution of Baseline and Endline evaluations by independent agency in selected police stations across Punjab, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu.
 



 \- Review and scrutinize the reports prepared by the evaluation agencies.
 



  





 4\. Engagement with Experts
 



  





 Assist the Project Director and Project Coordinator in engaging with Experts for vetting and finalization of the following activities:
 



  





 \- Finalization of Research Methodology
 



 \- Evaluation Parameters for (Baseline and Endline Evaluation)
 



 \- Change Manual prepared for all 3 states
 



 \- Baseline \& Endline Reports prepared by Evaluation agencies
 



 \- Final Project report (combined report for all 3 States)
 



  





 5\. Training
 



  





 \- Assist in the preparation of state\-specific training manual \& training materials.
 



 \- Support and participate in the conduct of training programmes for police office in all 3 states.
 



  





 6\. Project Implementation and Monitoring
 



  





 \- Support monitoring of project implementation across 90 police stations in three states, including field visits to selected police stations on quarterly basis.
 



  





 7\. Coordination
 



  





 Ensuring smooth communication, information exchange and prompt follow up with:
 



  





 \- All state project monitoring units (State Supervisor \& Research Associates in 3 states)
 



 \- External agencies engaged in data analysis (CESS, Hyderabad \& CGG, Hyderabad)
 



 \- Evaluation Agencies for Baseline \& Endline Evaluation in 3 states
 



 \- Donor Agency
 



  





 8\. Documentation and Reporting
 



  





 \- Documentation of Best Practice Visit reports submitted by the Project Coordinator, State Supervisors \& Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher (himself).
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to the Donor Agency as and when required.
 



 \- Preparation of the Final Project Report, based on Public consultation meetings, Change Manual, baseline and endline evaluation reports from the respective states and monthly reports from respective State Supervisors.
 



  





 9\. Miscellaneous
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher will report to the Project Director and Project Coordinator.
 



 \- In\-addition to the above\-mentioned job chart, the Project Director \& Project Coordinator may assign any other project related tasks from time to time.
 



  





 SALARY AND OTHER SERVICE CONDITIONS
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research): Rs. 75,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- Senior Researcher: Rs. 60,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- The selected candidate will have to give the undertaking in the form of the bond to serve for minimum period of one year.
 



 \- Economy\-class airfare for visits to various States and UTs
 



 \- Accommodation in police guest houses (or will be reimbursed as per IPF policy).
 



 \- Other service conditions will be governed by IPF HR and other policies
 



  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Selection will be based on a written examination and an interview (if you clear the written exam) to be held on 15th \& 16th October 2026 at IPF HQ New Delhi.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



  





 Please visit https://www.policefoundationindia.org/careers for detailed guidelines.
 



  





 \- Download the application form and fill it out electronically, along with updated CV in PDF format \& send them to us at recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com
 



 \- For queries, write to recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com or contact 9625878853 (Admin Officer) \& 9910224876 (Project Coordinator).
 



 \- Last date for online submission of applications: 5th October 2026 till 4:00 PM only.

title: Aladdin Data Risk, Controls & Governance, Director
description:
**About This Role**
**Role Overview**
 The Director in the Aladdin Data Risk team is expected to operate as a senior enterprise leader, owning the strategy, execution, and governance of risk management, data controls, and analytics stewardship across the Aladdin platform. This role requires the ability to shape direction, influence senior stakeholders, anticipate emerging risk, and drive scalable operating models that strengthen the integrity, quality, resilience, and commercial value of Aladdin’s data and analytics ecosystem. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to internal and external stakeholders, leading high\-impact initiatives that enhance risk controls, data quality, regulatory readiness, and platform maturity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Risk Management \& Controls
+ Set the strategic direction for Aladdin Data risk management frameworks and controls, ensuring they are scalable, audit\-defensible, commercially aligned, and resilient across evolving platforms, products, and regulatory expectations.
+ Lead complex, high\-priority incident management with executive judgment, coordinating across Engineering, Product, Client Businesses, Compliance, and senior leadership to drive timely remediation, transparent communication, and durable prevention.
+ Proactively strengthen regulatory and policy compliance by partnering with Audit, Compliance, Legal, and business leaders to translate expectations into clear controls, measurable outcomes, and sustainable operating discipline.

* Data Governance \& Quality
+ Own enterprise stewardship of critical analytics and risk data, ensuring data is governed, traceable, complete, accurate, and fit for senior leadership, client, audit, and regulatory consumption.
+ Define and institutionalize data quality standards, executive metrics, validation frameworks, and escalation mechanisms that create transparency, accountability, and measurable improvement across the data lifecycle.
+ Partner with Data Engineering, Product, and Governance teams to embed automated validation, control checks, lineage, and monitoring into data pipelines and operating workflows.

* Analytics Stewardship
+ Own and evolve analytics capabilities supported by the Aladdin Data platform, ensuring solutions are scalable, controlled, client\-relevant, and aligned to enterprise growth priorities.
+ Influence modeling, product, and engineering teams to ensure new risk models and analytics meet business needs, control expectations, and enterprise data quality standards before adoption.
+ Lead large\-scale testing, adoption readiness, and insight generation for quantitative financial models and analytics, translating complex findings into clear decisions for senior stakeholders.

* Strategic Leadership \& Collaboration
+ Define and drive a multi\-year roadmap for process engineering, control maturity, automation, and risk transformation aligned to enterprise objectives and Aladdin Data strategic priorities.
+ Operate as a senior integrator across Client Businesses, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Audit, and enterprise governance teams to deliver new analytics and business solutions, including climate, private credit, AI\-enabled data, and other emerging capabilities.
+ Build, coach, and elevate talent by setting a high bar for judgment, ownership, communication, and execution, while fostering an inclusive, accountable, and high\-performing team culture.

* Client Engagement
+ Serve as a senior trusted advisor to clients and executive stakeholders, framing complex risk and data issues clearly, managing expectations, and driving outcomes that reinforce confidence in Aladdin Data capabilities.
+ Lead client\-facing risk controls capabilities, including direct engagement on incidents, control enhancements, remediation strategies, and forward\-looking improvements to strengthen transparency and trust.


**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience leading data risk, controls, and governance functions within Aladdin or comparable enterprise\-scale data and analytics platforms
* Proven ability to own end\-to\-end enterprise risk and control frameworks across the data lifecycle, with clear accountability for design, adoption, monitoring, remediation, and executive reporting.
* Deep understanding of investment data, risk analytics, portfolio modeling environments, and platform\-scale data operations, with the ability to enforce data integrity, completeness, reliability, and usability across critical analytics outputs.
* Demonstrated experience leading Internal Audit, regulatory, and senior management engagements, including the ability to produce defensible evidence, clear narratives, and sustainable remediation plans.
* Demonstrated expertise in data privacy, protection, and responsible data use frameworks, including GDPR and enterprise policy obligations.
* Track record designing, implementing, and scaling enterprise policy frameworks and operating models that translate strategic intent into clear standards, controls, ownership, and adoption.
* Proven ability to define and execute strategic initiatives that materially strengthen enterprise risk posture, including:
+ Scaling control frameworks for new platforms, AI\-driven data capabilities, acquisitions, emerging asset classes, and evolving regulatory expectations.
+ Driving enterprise\-wide data governance adoption, ownership clarity, and operating model maturity across complex, global stakeholder groups.
+ Advancing monitoring, automation, issue detection, and management reporting capabilities that enable proactive risk identification and measurable control improvement.
+ Partnering cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Client Business, Compliance, Audit, and senior leadership to embed risk ownership into the operating fabric of the platform.

* Expertise designing and enforcing data quality controls, validation frameworks, lineage, metrics, and issue management processes that are scalable, measurable, and audit\-ready.
* Strong leadership experience managing senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams while driving change, accountability, and execution discipline in complex, matrixed environments.
* Exceptional ability to engage executive stakeholders, clients, and control partners as a credible, strategic advisor on data risk, governance, platform resilience, and regulatory readiness.


**Impact \& Growth**
* The Director in Aladdin Data Risk is expected to demonstrate the judgment, ownership, influence, and enterprise mindset of a high\-performing leader. Success in this role is measured by the ability to set strategy, mobilize stakeholders, deliver measurable control maturity, scale sustainable operating models, elevate talent, and strengthen confidence in Aladdin Data’s risk, governance, and analytics capabilities across clients, regulators, auditors, and senior leadership.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:

The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.

* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. title: Monitoring Evaluation Accountability Learning (MEAL) Specialist
description:
**Organizational Setting**
 The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through the FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to more efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production, better nutrition, a better environment and a better life, leaving no one behind.
   

  

 FAO is a specialized agency of the UN that leads international efforts to defeat hunger. FAO's goal is to achieve food security for all and ensure that people have regular access to enough high\-quality food to lead active, healthy lives. With 195 Members (194 countries and the European Union), FAO works in over 130 countries worldwide.
   

  

 The Global Environment Facility (GEF) has approved the Government of India's GEF\-7 project “Promotion of Sustainable Food Systems in India through Transforming Rice\-Wheat Systems in Punjab, Haryana, Odisha and Chhattisgarh” (GCP/IND/184/GFF), part of the GEF\-7 Food Systems, Land Use and Restoration (FOLUR) Impact Programme. The project objective is to promote sustainable, integrated landscapes and efficient food value and supply chains at scale in rice\- and wheat\-based food systems in India. It works across two contrasting agro\-ecological contexts: the intensive rice\-wheat systems of the Indo\-Gangetic Plain in Punjab and Haryana, and the biodiversity\-rich, forested rice\-growing landscapes of Chhattisgarh and Odisha.
   

  

 The project is organized around four components: (1\) integration of cross\-sector sustainability provisions into food systems and planning frameworks, (2\) enhanced capacities for climate\-smart food production practices and responsibly sourced commodity value chains, (3\) landscape management and restoration to sustain food systems and deliver global environmental benefits, and (4\) knowledge management to guide policies and maximize impacts. The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MoA\&FW) is the Project Executing Entity/Operational Partner, and the project is implemented through a National Project Management Unit (NPMU) at the national level and State Project Management Units (SPMUs) in each of the four target states, under the oversight of the National and State Project Steering Committees.
   

  

 The position is located in the FAO Country Office in India, within the project's NPMU.
   

  

**Reporting Lines**
 Under the overall supervision of the FAO Representative in India, the direct technical guidance of the National Technical Coordinator, and in coordination with the FAO Lead Technical Officer (LTO), .
   

  

**Technical Focus**
 The M\&E Specialist will perform qualitative and quantitative analysis of data collected by the NPMU, SPMUs and Operational Partners to report on project results. Monitoring and Evaluation (M\&E) of agriculture and food systems, and natural resource management projects.
   

  

**Tasks And Responsibilities**
 The incumbent will undertake the following duties:
   

  

* Based on the project's Results Framework and Theory of Change, develop and refine SMART indicators to track regular progress at output, outcome and objective levels, and define other monitoring and evaluation requirements at national and state levels of project implementation.
* Lead preparation of a detailed, fully budgeted Monitoring and Evaluation (M\&E) Plan for the project, defining data collection methods, frequency, responsibilities for data collection/analysis and means of verification for each indicator.
* Coordinate with MIS unit to identify and use appropriate indicators that capture the progress of the project in different states.
* Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis of data collected by the project team to report project results, including inputs to the annual Project Implementation Report (PIR), Narrative Progress Reports (NPRs) and Technical Reports.
* Coordinate the tracking, updating and reporting of GEF\-7 Core Indicators, Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) indicators and Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) indicators, at project mid\-term and closure, in line with FOLUR Impact Programme requirements.
* Review and discuss assessment, evaluation and monitoring results with FAO, the National Technical Coordinator, MoA\&FW and state\-level Operational Partners (SPMUs) and recommend corrective/adaptive management action.
* Support training of NPMU, SPMU and District Project Implementation Unit (DPIU) staff and partners on the project's Results Framework, M\&E system and reporting requirements.
* Develop methodologies and protocols for project M\&E, and support the Operational Partner in defining methodologies, timelines and quality assurance for the project's monitoring framework.
* Provide technical support for the design and Terms of Reference of impact evaluations, thematic studies and process\-monitoring studies, work with third\-party agencies/consultants engaged to oversee periodic evaluations, and review study reports and provide comments.
* Prepare the technical design document for the project's mid\-term review (MTR) and terminal evaluation (TE), in coordination with the National Technical Coordinator (NTC), Budget Holder (BH) and Lead Technical Officer (LTO).
* Elaborate, and support the periodic review and updating of, the project's Results Framework and Theory of Change, making recommendations to adapt these to project needs and to fill missing baseline information.
* Coordinate with the MEAL and Communications Expert(s) at SPMU level and with the project MIS to ensure consistent, harmonized data collection, reporting and knowledge management across the four target states.
* Support Operational Partners in preparing State and National Annual Work Plans and Budgets (AWP/B) that are clearly linked to Results Framework indicators.
* Participate in team meetings, briefings and Project Steering Committee meetings to present M\&E findings and conceptualize/propose approaches for assessing project impact and process indicators, both quantitative and qualitative.
* Contribute to addressing cross\-cutting issues such as gender, Indigenous Peoples' engagement and knowledge/communication planning, including ensuring gender\-disaggregated data collection within the M\&E system.
* Provide M\&E related advice and support to other thematic units in the project NPMU


**CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING**
**Minimum Requirements**
* Master’s degree in agriculture, Economics, Statistics, Rural Development, Development Studies, Environmental Sciences, or a related field.
* At least 8 years of progressively responsible professional experience in monitoring and evaluation and/or results\-based management of natural resource management, agriculture, rural development, climate change, sustainable food systems or related development projects.
* Working knowledge (Level C) of English
* National of India or resident of the country with a valid work permit.


**FAO Core Competencies**
* Results Focus
* Teamwork
* Communication
* Building Effective Relationships
* Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement


**Technical Skills And Competencies**
* Knowledge and demonstrated experience in project cycle management and results\-based MEAL, including Results Frameworks/logframes, Theories of Change, indicator development, target setting and results monitoring.
* Demonstrated knowledge of monitoring and evaluation methodologies and tools, including quantitative and qualitative data collection, data analysis, outcome monitoring, participatory approaches and data quality assurance.
* Familiarity with GEF monitoring and evaluation requirements, including GEF Core Indicators and Project Implementation Report (PIR) requirements.
* Experience in developing and operationalizing M\&E/MEAL plans, indicator protocols, data collection tools relating to Community Based Natural Resource Management (CBNRM) and agriculture/food systems, means of verification and data quality assurance mechanisms for development projects.
* Ability to analyse and interpret monitoring data and translate evidence into practical recommendations for adaptive management, project performance improvement and learning.
* Experience working with or in international non\-governmental organizations and donor organizations (UN agencies, World Bank, IFAD, Asian Development Bank, etc.) implementing participatory projects.
* Good data management, analytical, visualization and report\-writing skills, with the ability to present results clearly to technical teams, government counterparts and senior management.
* Familiarity with the agro\-ecological and socio\-economic context of Punjab, Haryana, Odisha and/or Chhattisgarh is an asset.


**Selection criteria**
* Full proficiency in English and Hindi is desirable, working knowledge of Punjabi, Odia or other languages spoken in the target states is an asset.
* Experience working with government agencies and multilateral/donor\-funded development projects will be an advantage.


**Additional Information**

The list can be accessed at http://www.whed.net/
* For additional employment opportunities visit the FAO employment website: http://www.fao.org/employment/home/en/

title: Senior Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
**Job Description \- Senior Analyst \- Supply Chain** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* Prior D2C or e\-commerce background — you already understand the complexity of order\-to\-delivery systems, multi\-node fulfilment, and the operational quirks of a high\-velocity consumer business, so you're not learning the domain from scratch
* A sharp analytical mind with genuine curiosity about how logistics networks, warehouses, and support operations actually work end to end
* Strong quantitative comfort — you can model fulfilment and logistics allocation, inventory positioning, vendor performance, and RTO/COD risk with real rigour
* A builder's instinct — you don't stop at a dashboard; you want to prototype the algorithmic product (an allocation engine, a fraud score, a routing rule) that fixes the problem programmatically
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to build working prototypes, not just slides
* Comfort operating across multiple functions at once — warehouse, logistics, customer support, production, and procurement all draw on your intelligence layer
* High ownership through to closure — you don't stop at 'I shared the analysis'; you track whether the fix actually moved the metric
* Ownership\-driven attitude — you investigate problems no one assigned to you and push recommendations through to adoption



  





**You should not apply if you:** 



* Don't have prior D2C or e\-commerce exposure — this role assumes you already understand that operating environment; it isn't a place to learn it from zero
* Are looking to run day\-to\-day warehouse or logistics operations — this is an intelligence and analytics role that informs ops, not an ops role itself
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to get conversant across WH, logistics, CS, production, and procurement context quickly
* Are uncomfortable holding several functions in your head at once and prioritizing across them
* See your job as ending at a report — here the goal is often a working algorithmic product, not just a recommendation
* Consider your job done once a dashboard ships — you need to keep watching it and flag when something breaks



  





**Skills Required:** 




  





**Must\-Have** 



* D2C / E\-commerce Background: hands\-on experience in a D2C, quick\-commerce, or high\-velocity consumer business — this is non\-negotiable, since it's what lets you understand the complexity of our systems from day one
* Supply Chain \& Logistics Analytics: reasoning about how orders should be allocated across fulfilment and logistics partners, and how a fulfilment network should evolve as the business scales
* COD \& RTO Risk Analysis: analysing order and delivery patterns to flag fraud and RTO risk
* Data Modelling \& SQL: comfortable querying and modelling on a warehouse (Redshift or similar) to build data cuts for multiple functions
* Algorithmic Product Thinking: able to scope and prototype rule\-based or lightweight algorithmic tools that automate a decision (allocation, routing, cancellation prediction) rather than just reporting on it
* Customer Support Ops Analytics: building scorecards for support quality/efficiency and identifying automation opportunities, including voice agent/IVR use cases
* Vendor Performance Analytics: analysing vendor\-level data (fill rate, quality, lead time, cost) to help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor or push for more utilization from one
* Structured Project \& Impact Tracking: taking a finding from problem statement and baseline through to a tracked project with a target KPI, and validating after the fact whether it actually moved the number
* Analytics Tools: Excel/Google Sheets for modelling and a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype logistics and CS intelligence tools quickly



  





**Good to Have** 



* Python for scripting data pulls, automations, or lightweight algorithmic prototypes
* Prior exposure to COD/RTO fraud protection systems
* Familiarity with WMS/OMS platforms or courier aggregators
* Exposure to voice agent/IVR or CS automation platforms
* Basic optimization or linear\-programming concepts for allocation/inventory problems



  





**What will you do?** 




**Fulfilment \& Logistics Allocation Intelligence** 



* Build data\-driven logic for how orders should be allocated across fulfilment locations and courier partners
* Assess how the fulfilment network should evolve as order volumes and geographies grow, and where new locations would help
* This kind of business case — going from a raw operational question to a data\-backed algorithm that runs the decision — is representative of the business cases and product algorithms you'll own end to end in this role



**Inventory Optimization** 



* Build models to project stock requirements at the fulfilment\-location level across the network
* Minimize stockouts and overstock by improving how inventory is positioned across locations



**COD \& RTO Fraud Protection** 



* Analyse COD order patterns to identify at\-risk pin codes, customers, and order profiles
* Build and monitor fraud/risk scoring systems that flag orders before dispatch



**Vendor Intelligence for Procurement** 



* Analyse vendor\-level performance — fill rate, quality, lead time, cost — to give procurement a clear, data\-backed view of each vendor
* Help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor versus when to push for greater utilization from one



**Customer Support Intelligence** 



* Build scorecards for CS quality and efficiency across support channels
* Identify automation opportunities, including voice agents, and monitor cancellation drivers and reduction levers



**AI \& Algorithmic Products for Supply Chain** 



* Partner with product and engineering to scope and prototype algorithmic tools that automate fulfilment, routing, and cancellation\-related decisions
* Push prototypes from spreadsheet logic to production\-ready tools where the impact justifies it



**Own Supply Chain \& Ops Reporting** 



* Be the single go\-to person for all supply chain and operations reporting — fulfilment, logistics, warehouse, inventory, and CS metrics
* Build and maintain the dashboards and MIS that warehouse, logistics, CS, and production teams rely on day\-to\-day
* Make sure every function has one consistent, trusted source of truth for its numbers instead of everyone pulling their own



**Proactive Monitoring \& Early\-Warning** 



* Closely monitor supply chain and ops KPIs so you're the first to know when something breaks — a fulfilment delay, a courier SLA slip, a spike in cancellations or RTO
* Build early\-warning indicators that catch a problem before it snowballs into a stakeholder escalation
* Flag anomalies proactively and get the right team looking at it immediately, rather than waiting to be asked



**Track Projects Through to Impact** 



* For every recommendation you drive, define the baseline, target KPI, owner, and timeline upfront
* Follow through post\-implementation to confirm whether the change actually moved the metric, not just that it shipped
* Maintain visibility of open supply chain and ops projects — status, risk, and expected versus actual impact



**Cross\-Functional Data Cuts** 



* Act as the single source of intelligence for warehouse, logistics, CS, production, and procurement teams
* Give each function the right data cuts, dashboards, and recommendations to act on



**Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication** 



* Present supply chain health, fraud trends, vendor risk, and automation impact to founders and functional heads
* Translate complex operational data into clear, actionable narratives



  





**Work Experience:** 




 3–5 years of experience, with a D2C/e\-commerce background required
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 




 • Friendly atmosphere
 



 • High learning \& personal growth opportunity
 



 • Flexible timings
 



 • Diverse work environment
 



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding:** 




 We raised $5 million in a Series A funding.

title: Automotive Market Analyst, India & ASEAN
description:
**The Role:** 
 Own high\-quality automotive market analysis and light\-vehicle forecasting for India, while contributing to ASEAN coverage. The analyst will combine structured data, local market knowledge and AI\-supported research tools to explain market movements, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver decision\-ready insights to clients and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* India market ownership. Maintain and improve market intelligence and forecasts for India, covering total market demand, segments, brands, models, powertrains and relevant policy or economic drivers.
* ASEAN regional analysis. Support coverage of key ASEAN markets, connect local developments to regional trends, and contribute to a consistent regional outlook and narrative.
* Forecasting and scenario analysis. Use Mobility Global forecasting platforms, external indicators and expert judgement to develop baseline and alternative scenarios; document assumptions and explain forecast changes clearly.
* Data quality and validation. Review incoming data, investigate anomalies, reconcile conflicting sources and work with data and product teams to strengthen accuracy, consistency and traceability.
* Market intelligence. Monitor regulation, taxation, industrial policy, macroeconomics, consumer demand, OEM strategy, new\-model activity, electrification and competitive developments across the region.
* Client insight and communication. Create concise reports, presentations and dashboards; respond to client questions; and present findings in a clear, commercially relevant way.
* Industry network. Build relationships with OEMs, associations, partners and other market contacts to validate assumptions, exchange insight and improve local market understanding.
* Cross\-functional contribution. Collaborate with global analysts, product, data science, sales and marketing teams; contribute regional expertise to thought leadership, webinars and client engagements.


**Required Skills**
* Education. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Statistics or a related discipline.
* Experience. Approximately 1\-3 years in automotive research, market intelligence, forecasting, consulting, data analytics or a closely related role. Strong candidates with transferable sector experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Regional expertise. Good understanding of the Indian automotive market and the factors shaping vehicle demand. Exposure to one or more ASEAN markets is a strong advantage.
* Analytical capability. Confidence working with large datasets, checking data quality, identifying patterns and translating results into a coherent market story.
* Tools. Advanced Excel and strong PowerPoint skills are required. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or comparable analytics tools is advantageous. Practical use of AI\-supported research or forecasting tools is welcome.
* Industry passion. Passion for automotive industry trends, especially alternative powertrains, connected mobility and digital transformation.
* Communication. Business\-level English, with strong writing, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills. Proficiency in any another relevant regional language is advantageous.


**About Mobility Global**
 Mobility Global is a leading provider of automotive market intelligence, forecasting, and strategic insights. We help OEMs, suppliers, financial institutions, and government agencies worldwide navigate the rapidly evolving mobility landscape. By transforming complex automotive data into actionable intelligence, we enable our clients to make informed decisions on vehicle demand, electrification trends, supply chain resilience, and market opportunities across global regions.

title: Senior Analyst Media
description:
What’s up?
 **We’re VaynerMedia!** 
 VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape,
   

  

 empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results.  VaynerMediaAPAC is strong with a world\-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time \-\-\- PEOPLE.  We day\-trade consumer attention, guiding our diverse clientele to focus on the platforms that command the attention of their specific customers. The Performance Marketing \& Analytics team plays a critical role in helping our internal teams and clients understand where attention is and how that is translating to impact on the business by creating data structures \& hierarchies, automated dashboards \& visualizations, integrating paid \& organic social listening data, and helping to build bespoke measurement solutions for our clients.
   

  

 We’re currently on the lookout for a team player who is a critical thinker, upbeat, and hungry to learn. **THE TASK AT HAND**

* Responsible for day to day analytics for assigned clients, including QA of data and reporting templates.
* Develop and present on\-going analytics deliverables to day to day clients coordinating with more analytics team members and account management.

* Basic understanding of concepts in at least one or more of the analytics disciplines.

* Support performance measurement and reporting across social media platforms including Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
* Leverage social listening, trend analysis, audience insights, and content performance data to identify opportunities for campaign optimization and business growth.


**PEOPLE WHO THRIVE IN THIS ROLE ALSO POSSESS:**
* 3 years of relevant experience in Media Analytics, Digital Marketing Analytics, Social Media Analytics, or Performance Marketing (Google, Meta and Publisher Campaigns).
* Result\-oriented with the ability to work within strict time constraints while balancing multiple projects.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization.
* A collaborative teammate with the knack to pivot in a constantly evolving environment.
* Knowledge of a variety of measurement methodologies and their applications.
* Passionate about research, television, marketing, emerging media, and technology.
* Strong PowerPoint/Excel and Google Slide/Sheet skills.
* Experience with one or more media platforms including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Tumblr, YouTube, DCM, DV360, The Trade Desk.
* Experience with SQL, Tableau.
* Strong understanding of Organic and Paid Social Media Management across platforms such as Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
* Experience in Social Media Strategy, Planning, Content Amplification, and Digital Marketing Campaign Optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads Planning and Execution, including Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, and Remarketing campaigns.
* Experience in audience targeting, performance tracking, campaign measurement, and reporting, particularly within Meta and other digital advertising platforms.
* Strong ability to analyze content performance, generate actionable insights, and translate findings into optimization recommendations.
* Experience with Social Listening, Community Management, and Trend Identification to support campaign and content strategies.
* Understanding of the synergy between organic and paid media channels and their role in maximizing campaign effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Strong Client Servicing and Stakeholder Management skills with the ability to independently manage client conversations and present strategic recommendations.
* Ability to develop integrated social media and measurement strategies while collaborating closely with creative, content, media, and analytics teams.
* Query and analyze complex data sets to develop actionable insights that enable the optimization of media and content.
* Analyze and correlate media campaign performance with audience data, including identification of high\-impact KPIs for tactics with a focus on audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, fan growth and content deep dives.


**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia**
 Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
   

  

 Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start\-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us.
 **We can’t wait to meet you.**

title: Program Officer – Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning

 Protsahan India Foundation is a center of excellence in innovation \& collaboration to eradicate Child Abuse so that all girls living in situations of vulnerability grow up empowered with access to education and healthcare in safe spaces, with greater freedom from all forms of abuse and violence. Girls and children who have experienced abuse or violence benefit from greater access to healing, care, support, gender justice, and other services needed to ensure physical, social and mental well\-being. Protsahan works cohesively to nurture girl champions from socially excluded backgrounds by bringing 21st\-century skills that endorse self\-learning and drive social and economic growth to enable an enriched and sustainable future for a young girl where she reaches her full potential.
   

  

 Additionally, Protsahan nurtures grassroots partnerships focused on Healing Childhood Trauma through comprehensive training, research, and advocacy initiatives. These efforts aim to fortify the child protection ecosystem and promote holistic well\-being for every child, particularly those in remote areas across India.
   

  

 To find out more about Protsahan visit
 **www.protsahan.co.in**
 The Program Officer – MEL will play a key role in translating field data and digital insights into clear, actionable evidence that strengthens program delivery across Protsahan’s work.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Program Officer – MEL will ensure that Protsahan’s program data is collected systematically and on a regular basis, maintained with high levels of accuracy, and regularly analysed to generate actionable insights for program improvement and organisational learning. The role will work closely with program teams to monitor implementation, identify gaps, track outcomes, and surface emerging trends. The Officer should be able to analyse and clearly represent both quantitative and qualitative data, translating complex findings into accessible insights, reports, and visualisations. The role will also involve working with diverse data sources including digital applications, social media platforms, and large datasets to identify patterns and strengthen evidence\-based decision\-making. Strong data analytics skills, including knowledge of BigQuery, SQL, dashboards, data extraction and management, and social and digital media trends, will be a significant advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring Programs**
* Implement monitoring and evaluation plans, formats, tools, and reporting systems across Protsahan programs and partners.
* Ensure program data is collected systematically and regularly.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and up\-to\-date program data.
* Conduct regular field visits and data verification checks to confirm reported data reflects on\-ground program implementation.
* Work with field teams to strengthen their understanding and use of monitoring data that is accurate, complete, and meaningful.


**Data Management \& Analysis**
* Collect and analyse quantitative and qualitative primary and secondary data, including data generated through monitoring, assessments, and evaluations.
* Conduct regular data quality checks to identify gaps, inconsistencies, anomalies, and data collection issues.
* Identify patterns, trends, gaps, emerging issues, and insights from the data to inform program decisions.
* Use basic Excel skills for data management, analysis, and reporting, and have working knowledge of SQL for querying and analysing data in BigQuery.
* Support assessments, evaluation studies, and other evidence\-generation initiatives, including tool development, fieldwork, analysis, and documentation.


**Digital and AI\-enabled Learning**
* Collect and analyse data from diverse digital sources, including social media platforms, digital applications, and large datasets, to track and interpret trends, patterns, and engagement.
* Use digital data to generate insights and inform decision\-making.
* Maintain and improve AI\-enabled learning tools, such as chatbots or digital assistants, that reinforce training and support frontline staff with day\-to\-day protocol questions.
* Keep AI\-enabled content accurate, up to date, and aligned with program protocols and safeguarding requirements, with appropriate human oversight.


**Knowledge Management**
* Maintain and update curriculum, facilitator resources, and AI chatbot content.
* Maintain and update Protsahan’s repository of program evidence, lessons learned, and field knowledge.
* Contribute to periodic learning reviews.
* Support the development and quality assurance of MEL tools including data collection formats, indicators, and reporting templates ensuring they stay accurate and consistent as program insights evolve.


**Candidate Requirements**
* Research rigor. You follow protocol on consent, data handling, and methodology.
* On case data, girls’ personal information, and anything gathered during fieldwork or research.
* Adaptability and Learning Agility: Comfortable working in a dynamic grassroots environment where priorities, systems, and approaches may evolve based on field realities and organisational needs.
* Analytical and Critical Thinking: Able to look beyond numbers and reports, identify meaningful patterns, ask the right questions, and distinguish between surface\-level trends and genuine insights. Including AI literacy with judgment i.e., you can maintain a working chatbot, and you know exactly where automation stops and human judgment must take over especially in programs involving girls.
* Ownership and Resourcefulness: Willing to take initiative \& solve problems independently with limited supervision.
